messages.終止符事務所フィクサー(ヒースクリフ)と組んで、S2「ターゲット指定」・S3「人: A Pierce attacker that pairs with Full-Stop Office Fixer Heathcliff to add follow-ups and coordinated attacks to S2 Target Marked and S3 Full-Stop to Life. Designed around that partnership and much weaker without Heathcliff.
messages.ターゲット捕捉: 終止符事務所ヒースクリフが出場中なら、S3では確定で、S2では: **Target Spotted**: While Heathcliff's Full-Stop Office Fixer is deployed, it always triggers with S3, and with S2 has a 20% chance per point of the highest Resonance (25% at higher Uptie). After Hong Lu's attack, Heathcliff makes a one-sided attack on the same enemy with Skill 2.
messages.バトルパッシブ「戦術的射撃支援」(傲慢×5・保有・同期化Ⅱで取得): ヒースクリ: **Combat passive — Tactical Fire Support (5 Pride Owned; unlocked at Uptie Ⅱ)**: If Heathcliff is in Overwatch Assignment or in backup, S2 and S3 are enhanced into Combo: Target Marked and Combo: Full-Stop to Life with more Coins. 5 Pride is hard to gather on his own, so allies' Pride is also needed.
messages.弾丸: S2・S3は消耗した弾丸1つごとに基本威力+1、さらにダメージ量も上がる: **Ammo**: S2 and S3 gain +1 Base Power per Ammo spent, plus more damage. Without Ammo, the attack is not cancelled, but that Coin's on-hit effects do not activate (passive Concentration).
messages.再装填: ターン開始時に弾丸が0なら守備が「影の向こう」に変わり、使うとターン終: **Reload**: If he has 0 Ammo at Turn Start, his Defense skill becomes Beyond the Shadow, which reloads at Turn End when used (once per battle).
messages.S3: 混乱区間を前進させ、Ⅲコインは対象が混乱状態ならクリティカルダメージ量+: **S3**: Shifts the Stagger Threshold, and Coin Ⅲ gains +30% Critical damage against staggered targets and inflicts Bind and Pierce Fragility on hit.
messages.ヒースクリフと同時に出撃させ、S2・S3でターゲット捕捉の追撃を引き出す。ヒース: Deploy him together with Heathcliff and draw out Target Spotted follow-ups with S2 and S3. When Heathcliff steps back in Overwatch Assignment or is in backup, hold 5 Pride to switch to the combo versions of S2 and S3. Build Poise with S1, and reload with Beyond the Shadow once he runs out of Ammo.
